title: Weighted Proportional Toll Sharing on General Highway Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.22892v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We extend the Segments Equal Sharing (SES) method of \citet{wu2024} from line highways to general highway networks, including networks with cycles. The input is an exogenously specified profile of route flows. We introduce the Weighted Proportional Sharing (WPS) method, which distributes each route's mileage revenue in proportion to weighted segment lengths and its fixed-surcharge revenue in proportion to positive segment surcharges. Route SES is recovered under homogeneous weights within each revenue component. We show that WPS is the sum of two weighted Shapley allocations and that the underlying route games extend the dividend and Shapley representation of linear SES. Two axiomatic characterizations identify WPS. The first uses additivity and proportional treatment of segments used on every positive-revenue route. translated_title: 一般公路网络上的加权比例通行费分摊
translated_abstract: 我们将 Wu 等人（2024）提出的路段均等分摊（SES）方法从线性高速公路推广到一般公路网络，包括含环路的网络。其输入为外生给定的路径流量分布。我们提出了加权比例分摊（WPS）方法，该方法将每条路径的里程收入按加权路段长度成比例分配，并将其固定附加费收入按正附加费路段的附加费成比例分配。在每个收入组成部分内采用同质权重时，即可恢复路径 SES。我们证明 WPS 是两个加权 Shapley 分配之和，且其背后的路径博弈扩展了线性 SES 的红利与 Shapley 表示。我们给出两个公理化刻画来唯一确定 WPS：第一个基于可加性以及对每条正收入路径均使用的路段的比例化处理；第二个在路径取消规则下结合了子高速公路效率与加权平均平衡贡献。
tldr: 本文提出加权比例分摊（WPS）方法，将路段均等分摊（SES）方法从线性高速公路推广到含环路的一般公路网络，证明其可表示为两个加权 Shapley 分配之和，并给出两个公理化刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Weighted Proportional Sharing (WPS) method, extending the Segments Equal Sharing (SES) method from line highways to general highway networks with cycles, and characterizes it as the sum of two weighted Shapley allocations via two axiomatic characterizations.
